title: Anthropic API Overloaded Error During Request Retry Sequence
body:
**Bug Description**
there is no response and I have Error "API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 8 seconds… (attempt 5/10)
  ⎿  API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
  ⎿  API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 19 seconds… (attempt 6/10)"

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal

- Feedback ID: 8a4c08de-3bfc-40af-9a89-94d062cdd1db

top_comments.body: How am I supposed to work like this? I am on the max 200 USD plan. All of the cursor users are flocking to Claude code. I should be getting more priority due to me paying more than the other users. I will remember this when Gemini's CLI gets better, Anthropic ;)

top_comments.body:
I am seeing a good number of these as well, and I can't say for sure, but it certainly seems like Anthropic have 10x reduced the quota of my 5x plan. I used to be able to run the whole day, but even with light use (no planning, loading up lots of context) I am about to hit my limit.

Ain't no way this is worth 90GBP a month.
